d: Angus Sinclair, called Scotland's worst serial killer, is linked to the 1977 murders of two girls in Edinburgh.
In an emotional tribute, witnesses and victims' relatives look back on the tragic murder of 16 children and a teacher at Dunblane Primary School in Scotland, 15 years ago.
An investigation into the Moors Murderers, Myra Hindley and Ian Brady, with interviews with the family of Keith Bennett.

In September 2003, 17-year-old Justine Vanderschoot disappeared, prompting an exhaustive investigation by law enforcement. Initially, police discovered her abandoned vehicle at a park-and-ride lot with no indication of foul play.
The peace and quiet that a summer's night brings is interrupted by a 911 call from Walter Simpson. He tells the dispatch of the horrifying sight that he has come home to.

Lithia, Florida, 2018. This small, quiet community is rattled when two residents find the body of a woman on their lawn  bloodied and bruised. Police rush to the scene only to discover that this woman is Kay Baker, a local math teacher and a mom.

The body of Joette Smith was discovered floating in the San Lorenzo River near Ben Lomond. The case remained unsolved for nearly four decades until authorities revisited the evidence and utilized advancements in forensic technology.
